title: Baked Croation Fish with Warm Bisque
description: A hearty and flavorful fish dish from the Mediterranean, served with a side of warm bisque.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the cod fish fillets on the baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish, then sprinkle the garlic and oregano on top.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake the fish in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, heat the warm bisque in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the fish is done, serve it with a side of warm bisque.
Garnish with lemon wedges and fresh parsley, if desired.
